metadata.title: IBM Has a Chance to Rewrite Its Narrative. Can Earnings Spark a Comeback?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
IBM Has a Chance to Rewrite Its Narrative. Can Earnings Spark a Comeback?
As International Business Machines prepares to report third-quarter earnings after the closing bell Wednesday, the company has a prime opportunity to rewrite its narrative—though it faces a remarkably high bar.
